translations.web: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’”
translations.bsb: Then He said to me, ‘Go! I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’”
translations.kjv: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
translations.asv: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee forth far hence unto the Gentiles.
